text:
marta_cs: Heads-up — HelioWorks dedicated pool bring-up scheduled for Thu. Need to lock quota, autoscale windows, and a short ops runbook. Who can join the ramp/slope smoke test?

jake_te: I can own the traffic script and monitoring hooks. What target QPS and token sizes do we want to validate?

priya_eng: Recommended: steady 600 req/s with average ~5s generation, worst-case 8k token context. Also verify burst to 2k req/s for 5m windows. We should validate KV cache hit behavior under ramp too.

olivia_sre: I can provision a canary lane in staging. Plan autoscale policy: min=2, target_util=65%, max=10 for the first pass. Will also schedule a controlled drain after test.

marta_cs: Perfect. @jake_te can you post the load command + quick checklist so CS can invite HelioWorks PM + infra contacts?

jake_te: Sure — basic run I used locally:

```
# ramp_slope test (example)
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 15m --script ramp_slope.js --env TARGET=https://dedicated-helio.api.redwood
# tweak VUs to simulate slope -> 200 -> 600 -> 2k burst in waves
```

jake_te: I'll parameterize token sizes in the script and include a warmup wave.

sam_se: Add a cache-priming wave: 20% of traffic hitting representative prefixes for 10 minutes before the main ramp. That helps measure prefix/KV effectiveness.

deploy-bot: Canary created: helio-dedicated-canary-1 by olivia_sre :white_check_mark:

priya_eng: Capture metrics: latency p50/p95/p99, token/sec, model GPU mem utilization, and p99 cold-start. Use the metrics endpoint: `GET /internal/metrics?range=1h&names=token_rate,lat_p95,gpu_util` and tag with `team:helio`.

marta_cs: I'll schedule a 30m enablement session after the test (Wed 10am PT) to walk the HelioWorks ops team through autoscale knobs and fallback policy. Also flagging renewal risk — they hit committed quota last month and asked about additional capacity.

olivia_sre: Noted renewal risk. Add to account-health board and include a runbook step: if burst target fails (can't reach 2k), automatically route overflow to shared-hosted tier for 5m and notify on-call.

jake_te: I'll post the test artifacts (scripts + raw k6 output) to this thread after the run and attach a short grafana dashboard link.

priya_eng: If token cost looks higher than forecast, try the `q4_8` quant profile on a canary model variant — should give ~30% token-cost reduction with small latency impact. I'll prepare the variant and perf notes.

marta_cs: Action items: jake -> upload scripts & outputs; olivia -> create canary and configure autoscale; priya -> prepare quant suggestion and dashboards; sam -> confirm cache-priming wave; me -> run enablement + update renewal tracker and follow up with HelioWorks PM. Sending calendar invites now. :thumbsup:

olivia_sre: I'll also run a quick pre-check tonight to ensure logging and trace hooks are wired. Will post results here.

marta_cs: Thanks everyone — let's keep this thread for post-test notes and final go/no-go call.
